sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a "Date info" family to the unique-values (📊) dropdown, applying automatically to every column fed into a `dateParts` extractor on every pageType (e.g. "Date", "Begin", "End", "Release date" — no per-pageType feature flag needed): "- Precision" is a fixed 3-flag count (📅 complete dates / 🌓 partial dates / ↔️ date ranges, from the new `_findCellDateExpressionParts()`'s own classification of each cell's raw "YYYY[-MM[-DD]]" or dash-joined-range text — never one entry per distinct date value, since that already duplicates the plain column-value list); "- Decade" and "- Month" are open per-value lists bucketing each date's own year (`_dateAtomDecade()`, e.g. "1970-1980") and calendar month name (`_dateAtomMonth()`, e.g. "August", sorted calendar order not alphabetically). A range contributes BOTH its start and end independently to Decade/Month (deduped per row), so e.g. "1973-08-09 – 1973-09-23" counts toward both "August" and "September". Checking an entry narrows the table and highlights the matching text — the whole date expression for a Precision flag, or only the specific matching atom for a Decade/Month entry (so an unrelated side of a range stays unhighlighted).
